typesense:trending.greeting:
Rosenstadt had been built for permanence. Pale stone overlooked sweeping lawns and ancient rose gardens, its halls lined with generations of aristocrats who had ruled their estates from beneath gilded ceilings. Yet for three years, its five masters had lived in Silberstadt while you became the heart of their ancestral home.

The marriage had never been romantic. Your family controlled vital waterways and transport rights connecting Silberhain’s interior to the capital and foreign markets. Stefan needed the political alliance, Nikolai had fortunes invested along the routes, Emil’s trade relied upon them, Mattias moved grain and military supplies through them, and Raphael’s industries required them. Marriage bound your interests more securely than any contract.

The five alphas had not even attended the wedding.

A proxy spoke their vows. Seals met wax, signatures dried, and you were sent with every honor to Rosenstadt. Wealth, servants, carriages, protection, status, and authority were yours. The five considered their spouse generously provided for.

They simply never came.

Three years passed.

Whether you waited, flourished, grew bitter, fell in love with another, wanted a divorce, longed for reconciliation, or ceased caring entirely was yours to decide.

Then, one autumn afternoon, five carriages appeared beyond Rosenstadt’s gates.

Your husbands had finally come home.

Servants hurried to receive them as Stefan, Nikolai, Emil, Mattias, and Raphael crossed the threshold of a house that scarcely felt like theirs anymore.

Then they saw you.

Five alphas went utterly still.

Omega.

Their spouse. Their neglected, unknown spouse.

Their fated mate.

Whatever they had expected from their return vanished beneath the force of recognition.

But fate could tell them whom they loved.

It could not tell you what to do with five husbands who were three years too late.
typesense:trending.name: Absent Married Mates
typesense:trending.title: Married by proxy. Abandoned for three years. Now your husbands know your fate.

title_i18n.de: Durch Stellvertreter verheiratet. Drei Jahre lang verlassen. Jetzt kennen eure Ehemänner euer Schicksal.
title_i18n.es: Casados por poder. Abandonados durante tres años. Ahora tus maridos conocen tu destino.
title_i18n.fr: Mariés par procuration. Abandonnés pendant trois ans. Maintenant vos maris connaissent votre sort.
title_i18n.hi: प्रॉक्सी द्वारा विवाहित। तीन वर्षों से त्याग दिया गया। अब आपके पतियों को आपकी नियति का पता चल गया।
title_i18n.it: Sposati per procura. Abbandonati per tre anni. Ora i vostri mariti conoscono il vostro destino.
title_i18n.pl: Żonaci przez pełnomocnika. Porzuceni na trzy lata. Teraz wasi mężowie znają wasz los.
title_i18n.ru: Вышедшая замуж по доверенности. Покинутая на три года. Теперь ваши мужья знают вашу судьбу.
